name: html-runtime-form-fallback-metadata
description: Converts simple contact and newsletter forms into readable grouped blocks while preserving submission behavior metadata.

source_reference.notes: Simple non-search forms become readable labels and inert button blocks while action-backed submit behavior stays in fallback metadata.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.

input.content: <main><form action="/contact" method="post"><label>Name <input name="name" required></label><label>Email <input name="email" type="email"></label><textarea name="message" aria-label="Message"></textarea><button type="submit">Send</button></form><form action="/newsletter" method="post" class="newsletter"><label>Email <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="you@example.com"></label><button type="submit" value="subscribe">Subscribe</button></form></main>
